plan.bed: a scratch copy (stagekit.Stage.scratch) of a small claudeDev VI holding one While Loop, one Add, one Case, one Flat Sequence, two panel controls - created and deleted in the run

inputs.call: call it once on the scratch bed with the arguments its stagexec route passes (stagexec.LVBackend)
inputs.predict: no exception; outcome ok; the census / step diff the route declares

predicted.note: no fncontract.TABLE row (recipe function): predicted = returns without exception and the caller's census/step diff matches the plan

plan.pass_if: every input's prediction holds AND the call's standard outcome is the predicted one; handle count flat (+-100) over the run
plan.runs_in: card chat-F3 (real LabVIEW); never this card
